definitions.short: Azriel , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H5837. Azriel עַזְרִיאֵל proper name, masculine ( my help is El ); — Ες ( δ ) ριηλ , etc., 1 Jer 36:26 . 2 a Manassite 1Chr 5:24 . 3 name in Naphtali 1Chr 27:19 .

occurrences.englishText: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: even Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;
The king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; but Yahweh hid them.
